Yes, that's the right direction. Saving a link fast, tagging it, and being able to find it again — by search, by tag, or in a read-later view — is exactly the heart of it, and editing, deleting, and opening links belong right there with it. I'm happy to leave notes, offline copies, and archiving for later.

One thing I'd want as part of that core save flow: when I paste a link, the app should pull in the page's title and description automatically so I'm not typing everything by hand. And if I happen to paste a link I've already saved, I'd rather it take me to edit the existing one than end up with duplicates. Other than that, you've got it.
